youtube.description:
Didi ne poocha: "Meri behen ka operation hai, periods aa gaye toh?" 🌸
Dr Saathi ne kaha: Didi, ghabraiye mat, aam taur par operation ho jaata hai! 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Periods mein aam taur par operation nahi rukta
✅ Hospital pahunchte hi nurse ko bata dijiye, woh pad aur madad dengi
✅ Operation ke aas-paas tampon nahi, pad behtar hai, infection se bachaav ke liye
✅ Operation ki tension se bhi kabhi-kabhi periods aa jaate hain, ghabraiye mat
Koi bhi sawaal ho, apne doctor se poochhiye.
